On the girls side our own Jessica Dash won the Girls 800 metres, and of the boys, Sean McLean and Stanley Osuide were first and second in the high jump while Peter Lloyd took the 800 metres.
Star of the year was Peter Lloyd, who captured the Middlesex Cross Country title, was individual winner of the Surrey Cross Country League and 2nd in the London Schools.

Peter Lloyd has had an outstanding Cross Country season as a Colt this winter. He won the individual colts award for the lowest points score in the Surrey League, winning the races at Petersham and Dorking and coming second at Wimbledon, He won the Middlesex Cross Country Championships at Alexander…

Stars of the future in action at the Club Championships. Ross Bentley (15) and Peter Lloyd (35) storm away from the 400 metre start. Both ended up as winners because Ross is a Colt and Peter a Boy, and both races were combined.
